page: Running Hono on AWS Lambda@Edge serverless platform at CloudFront edge locations. Customizes HTTP request/response behaviors. Node.js 18+ support. Setup: CDK for infrastructure (CloudFront, IAM, functions). Initialize: cdk init app -l typescript, install hono. Hello World: Hono app with handle() from hono/lambda-edge. Deploy: CDK Stack configuration with NodejsFunction, CloudFront Distribution, S3 origin. cdk deploy command. Callback pattern: c.env.callback() for continuing after verification (e.g., Basic Auth). Types: Callback, CloudFrontRequest from hono/lambda-edge. Edge Lambda event types: VIEWER_REQUEST. Questions: How do I set up Lambda@Edge? How do I configure CDK? How do I use callback? What event types exist?

sections.manifest: Lambda@Edge setup with CDK. Initialize: cdk init app -l typescript. Install: npm i hono (or yarn, pnpm, bun). Create: mkdir lambda directory. Project structure ready for CDK infrastructure. Questions: How do I initialize? What packages?

Hello World Lambda@Edge function. File: lambda/index_edge.ts. Imports: Hono, handle from 'hono/lambda-edge'. Code: new Hono(), app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Hono on Lambda@Edge!')), export const handler = handle(app). Basic function setup. Questions: What's the entry file? How do I export handler?

CDK deployment configuration. Files: bin/my-app.ts (CDK app), lib/my-app-stack.ts (stack definition). bin/my-app.ts: imports, CDK App, MyAppStack instance with region us-east-1. lib/my-app-stack.ts: NodejsFunction config (entry lambda/index_edge.ts, handler, runtime NODEJS_20_X), S3Bucket for origin, CloudFront Distribution with S3Origin, edgeLambdas with VIEWER_REQUEST event type. Deploy: cdk deploy. Questions: What's the stack structure? How do I configure CloudFront? How do I add edge functions?

Callback for request processing continuation. Types: Callback, CloudFrontRequest from 'hono/lambda-edge'. Bindings: { callback: Callback, request: CloudFrontRequest }. Usage: basicAuth middleware, then c.env.callback(null, c.env.request) to continue. Pattern: verify auth, continue with callback. Example: protected routes with auth. Questions: How do I use callback? How do I continue after auth? What's Callback type?
